proves.claim: With slices.composeLanding on, pullboard merged records the parent landed and withdraws its submitted slice as landed with the parent.

cli.io-commands-merged.compose-landing-o.why: Without it, the store's slice closing is never reached from a real landing and every slice stays submitted.

proves.claim: With slices.composeLanding off, a parent's landing leaves its slice submitted.

cli.io-commands-merged.compose-landing-o.why: Without it, the setting could close slices for repos that never turned it on.
